name: Common LLM ad mistakes → exact fixes
instruction: Before delivery, scan the draft against every item. If a mistake matches, rewrite using the fix and good_example pattern.

mistakes.mistake: Opens with brand name or ‘Hey guys welcome back’
mistakes.why: Burns the thumb-stop on identity the viewer doesn’t care about.
mistakes.fix: Open on problem, format signal, spectacle, or confession. Brand after 8–12s.
mistakes.bad: Hi, we’re GlowLab — the future of skincare!
mistakes.good: POV: your makeup finally stays put through a double shift…

mistakes.mistake: Feature laundry list as the script
mistakes.fix: State one JTBD. Features only as proof of the mechanism.
mistakes.bad: We have 12 vitamins, vegan, cruelty-free, recyclable, fast shipping…
mistakes.good: Stop midday crash — one scoop, 20 minutes, back in the zone. (Here’s what’s in it if you care…)

mistakes.mistake: Invented reviews, CTR, ROAS, or celebrity use
mistakes.fix: Use only user-supplied proof or [PLACEHOLDER: review].
mistakes.good: [PLACEHOLDER: paste 1–2 real reviews] — or omit social proof this cut.

mistakes.mistake: Fake UGC that looks like a studio commercial
mistakes.fix: Either commit to native_ugc (handheld, imperfect) or premium_cinema (honestly cinematic).
mistakes.bad: Ring light, perfect script, logo lower-third, stock smile
mistakes.good: Front camera, messy desk, jump cuts, one honest stumble left in

mistakes.mistake: Trend used with no product truth punchline
mistakes.fix: Format = vehicle. Punchline must equal the offer’s wedge.
mistakes.good: Same dance timing, lyric beat replaced with ‘when the app actually…’ then 2s demo

mistakes.mistake: Multiple CTAs in one cut
mistakes.fix: One primary CTA. Put alts in A/B matrix only.
mistakes.bad: Like, follow, comment SALE, tap cart, link in bio, shop now!
mistakes.good: Comment SALE — I’ll DM the link.

mistakes.mistake: Script without timecodes / beats
mistakes.why: Agents write essays; editors can’t shoot it.
mistakes.fix: Always emit timed beats from a flow id.
mistakes.good: 0–2s visual hook / 2–8s pain / 8–18s mechanism / 18–25s proof / 25–28s CTA

mistakes.mistake: Ignores muted viewing
mistakes.fix: Hook must read as text overlay or pure visual.
mistakes.bad: All meaning only in VO whisper
mistakes.good: Huge on-screen ‘BEFORE’ + visual; VO optional

mistakes.mistake: Landing page promise mismatch
mistakes.fix: Mirror hook language above the fold; same SKU/offer/geo.
mistakes.bad: Ad: 50% off serum. Landing: brand homepage carousel
mistakes.good: Ad and landing both: ‘50% off Barrier Serum — today only’

mistakes.mistake: Assumes trending audio is free for paid
mistakes.fix: Flag rights. Use licensed/original for paid; trend audio organic-only unless cleared.
mistakes.bad: Just use that viral song in Spark Ads
mistakes.good: Organic: trend sound. Paid twin: original bed + same cadence.

mistakes.mistake: Pretty cinema with no job-to-be-done
mistakes.why: Brand film vanity without commercial lift.
mistakes.fix: Spectacle → desire → capability → signature. Pair with DR twin.
mistakes.good: Same grade, but product does one undeniable thing by 0:18; endcard explores

mistakes.mistake: Over-scripted influencer brief
mistakes.fix: Must-say / do-not-say / optional hooks; let delivery stay theirs + FTC disclose.
mistakes.good: 3 must-say truths, 2 banned claims, 5 hook options, required demo shot

mistakes.mistake: Wrong aspect ratio / length for platform
mistakes.fix: TikTok/Reels/Shorts: 9:16. Meta feed often 4:5. YouTube/CTV: 16:9 + vertical cutdowns.
mistakes.good: Shoot vertical master; crop horizontal from center or second framing

mistakes.mistake: Cliffhanger Part 1 with no Part 2 outlined
mistakes.fix: Outline all parts before publishing.
mistakes.good: Part1 hook → Part2 mechanism → Part3 offer/proof scheduled

mistakes.mistake: Medical/finance absolute claims
mistakes.fix: Use approved language; defer to professionals; no guarantees.
mistakes.good: Supports calm routines / invest knowing risk — talk to an advisor

mistakes.mistake: Comparison that illegally smears a trademark
mistakes.fix: Compare to ‘old way’ / category, not fake competitor claims.
mistakes.good: OLD: three apps and a spreadsheet. NEW: one flow.

mistakes.mistake: Empty ‘comment if you agree’ bait
mistakes.fix: Comment keyword unlocks a real asset, or pose a real debate.
mistakes.good: Comment CHECKLIST and I’ll send the 1-pager

mistakes.mistake: No A/B matrix — single fragile idea
mistakes.why: First cut rarely wins; agents should propose tests.
mistakes.fix: Always include 3-variant matrix: hook, proof, CTA, or posture.
mistakes.good: A silent spectacle / B UGC confession / C offer-first

mistakes.mistake: Writing ‘viral’ without choosing a trend class
mistakes.fix: Pick a class from viral-operating-system.json and name it.
mistakes.good: Trend class: format_meme (POV). Payload: [identity state].

mistakes.mistake: Mixing production tiers in one confused cut
mistakes.fix: Pick a tier. Or deliver two separate twins.
mistakes.bad: Handheld confession + orchestral trailer grade mid-sentence
mistakes.good: Cut A native_ugc. Cut B premium_cinema. Same JTBD.
